_comment: Student trial mode. Served at / with no individual login.
class_code: one shared code everyone types. Set to "" to open the trial with no gate.
duration_seconds: hard limit, enforced on the server. 600 = 10 minutes.
warn_at_seconds: countdown turns red and warns with this many seconds left.
ask_participant_code: show an optional participant-code field on the landing page.
Set enabled to false to take the trial down and serve the staff login at / instead.
